summary.name: Comparison of wiki software
summary.one_liner: A Wikipedia reference page with large comparison tables of general information, target audience, features, and installation requirements for many wiki software packages.
use_cases: compare wiki engines before choosing one
find an open source wiki for a team
check wiki license and programming language
pick a wiki that supports LaTeX math
find a self-hosted wiki for an intranet
review wiki features like access control and WYSIWYG editing
summary.what_it_does: The page compares many wiki software packages in several tables. The general table lists creator, first release date, latest stable release, predecessor, license, open-source status, programming language, and data backend. Other tables cover target audience (public, private, enterprise, education, intranet, personal, scientific use), features such as file attachments, spam prevention, page access control, WYSIWYG editing, web feeds, export/import, extensibility, and automatic TOC, and installation details like platform, web server, and dependencies. Systems no longer in active development are marked with a light purple background.
notable: Covers dozens of wiki packages across general, audience, feature, and installation tables
Marks systems no longer in active development
Lists license, programming language, and data backend for each wiki
caveats: Page notes that some sections possibly contain original synthesis and that the installation table may contain original research
Many entries are proprietary rather than open source, and some tables have incomplete or dated entries
